Our actions ripple throughout the Shroud, drawing us closer to beings of great power. If we find favor with these entities, we might then channel their psionic energy into corporeal reality. # 意志之力 / The Power of Will

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

获得任一赞助者契合度时（on_attunement_gained）检查：契合度≥0.5、已突破虚境且未曾发生（power_of_will）。

Checked whenever attunement is gained (on_attunement_gained): attunement ≥ 0.5, Shroud breached, not yet happened (power_of_will).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

我们在虚境中的活动开始影响现实；“灵能光环”理论提供了把这种影响变为持续之力的途径。

Our activity in the Shroud begins to affect real space; the theory of "Psionic Auras" offers a way to make that influence constant.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：若尚未掌握，把“灵能光环”加入研究选项并获得10%进度。

Only option: if not yet known, adds Psionic Aura to the research options with 10% progress.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文按是否已遭遇过光环、是否嗜杀分四种。

Four texts by prior aura encounter and homicidal status.
